value.text: Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2C with scapuloperoneal muscular atrophy overlap syndrome and scapuloperoneal spinal muscular atrophy

phenotypicFeatures.description: difficulty in playing sports since childhood
weakness in his four limbs
difficulty holding objects and walking upstairs
numbness in both hands and feet
limb muscle weakness progressively aggravated with atrophy
severe scapula muscle atrophy with sloping shoulders
Distinct muscle atrophy was also present in the thenar
Distinct muscle atrophy was also present in the ... lower limbs
Muscle strength was bilaterally 4/5 in elbow extension, 2/5 in finger extension, 2/5 in hip extension and 0/5 in ankle dorsiflexion
Deep tendon reflexes were absent in both the upper and lower extremities
Pinprick and vibration sensations were absent in the feet and moderately reduced in the hands
glucose level was slightly elevated at 7.1 mmol/L and his glycated hemoglobin was 7.1%
Echocardiography manifested a thick interventricular septum
MRI indicated mild atrophy of bilateral thigh muscles
The calf muscle was also atrophic with fat infiltration
The brachial plexus was symmetrically hypertrophy and hyperintense

type.label: Decreased compound muscle action potential amplitude

phenotypicFeatures.description: amplitudes of compound muscle action potentials (CMAPs) were reduced in ulnar nerves and were absent in bilateral peroneal nerves

type.label: Decreased amplitude of sensory action potentials

phenotypicFeatures.description: Sensory nerve action potentials (SNAPs) were not evoked in the right median, ulnar, sural or superficial peroneal nerves
Electromyogram (EMG) showed fibrillation and positive sharp waves in partial muscles

type.label: Abnormal single motor unit action potential

phenotypicFeatures.description: Increased duration and large amplitude of motor unit potentials (MUPs) were found in bilateral calf muscles

type.label: Decreased number of peripheral myelinated nerve fibers

phenotypicFeatures.description: severe reduction in the density of myelinated fibers
scattered pseudo-onion bulbs formed by regenerating clusters
denervated Schwann cell bands, scattered myelinated axons, and numerous unmyelinated fibers regeneration
